publication.edition: Penguin Classics; translations of 12th-century Kannada vachanas by Basava, Akka Mahadevi, Allama Prabhu and others

verification.verification_notes: Publication (Penguin, 1973; ISBN 9780140442700) verified via Open Library. Used for the vachana form's anubhava (direct experience), ankita (named closing invocation: 'Lord of the Meeting Rivers', 'Lord, white as jasmine'), embodied sacred, and bedagu paradox; described structurally, no passages reproduced.

limitations: Kannada oral cadence, occupational register, and bedagu wordplay are flattened in English; Ramanujan's renderings have themselves been critiqued as universalizing (see Niranjana 1992). Claims here are structural, not acoustic.
